verdict.rationale: Container tags provide hard isolation per user/tenant (docs-4, docs-38), and MCP/space features let teams share a common authorized context (docs-11, docs-36), supporting both private per-user memory and shared team memory. However there is no explicit documentation of fine-grained cross-tag sharing/permissions (e.g., granting one agent read access to another's tag while keeping other data private) or role-based access control across container tags. missing for 10: explicit cross-tag sharing/permission model, role-based access controls, independent/hands-on verification of team-vs-private isolation in practice.
